title: fix(getRefinements): hierarchical facets
body:
Bug fix of not retrieving the count on a hierarchical facet

It now only returns the last value (will be needed by `currentRefinedValues`).

Incidentally, getRefinements now also returns the type of facet for convenience.

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito, @vvo and @pixelastic to be potential reviewers

Thanks for the PR!

> Bug fix of not retrieving the count on a hierarchical facet

I have carefully read the test diff but fail to see where we missed the count? Only thing I see is that the datastructure for hierarchical facet was not the same than the others (missing {name, count}).

> It now only returns the last value

Can you precise what do you mean here?
